title: Timed canonizer startup
statement: Let $c$ be an effective machine code and let $b$, $\alpha$, and $x$ be finite Boolean strings. After exactly $4|b|+3|\alpha|+8$ steps, the timed canonizer started on $\langle\langle b,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$ is in the buffered second-phase configuration formed from the canonizer's initial configuration on $\alpha$, with tag true, input-head position $4|b|+2|\alpha|+7$, buffer tapes containing $b$, and their heads at position $|b|$.
replaced:
Let $c$ be an effective machine code, and let $b$, $\alpha$, and $x$ be finite Boolean
strings. After exactly $4|b|+3|\alpha|+8$ steps on $\langle\langle
b,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$, the timed canonizer's configuration equals the buffered
second-phase configuration formed from the canonizer's initial configuration on
$\alpha$, with tag true, input-head position $4|b|+2|\alpha|+7$, copies of the buffer
tape holding $b$, and corresponding heads at $|b|$.
